title.zh: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Warns of Midterms Payback After Clarity Act Fails
title.en: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Warns of Midterms Payback After Clarity Act Fails

current_state.zh: The Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act in a procedural vote, prompting Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto to warn of electoral consequences and add the vote to its lawmaker scorecards ahead of the midterms.
current_state.en: The Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act in a procedural vote, prompting Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto to warn of electoral consequences and add the vote to its lawmaker scorecards ahead of the midterms.
